# thunder_ddos_ip_filtering_policy_rule (Resource)

`thunder_ddos_ip_filtering_policy_rule`: IP filter rule configuration

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_filtering_policy_name` (String) Ip_filtering_policy_name
- `seq` (Number) Sequence number

### Optional

- `action` (String) 'drop': Drop the packet (default); 'permit': Skip afterword rules and continue other ddos process; 'blacklist': Blacklist source hosts with glid; 'bypass': Bypass all other ddos process rules and forward;
- `dst_ip` (String) IPv4 Subnet address
- `dst_ipv6` (String) IPv6 Subnet address
- `dst_port` (Number) Match only packets with the port number
- `dst_port_end` (Number) Ending Port Number
- `dst_port_start` (Number) Match only packets in the range of port numbers (Starting Port Number)
- `glid` (String) Global limit ID
- `icmp_code` (Number) ICMP code
- `icmp_type` (Number) ICMP message type
- `proto_num` (Number) IP proto number
- `protocol` (String) 'tcp': TCP; 'udp': UDP; 'icmp-v4': ICMP; 'icmp-v6': ICMPv6; 'number': Specify IP protocol number;
- `src_ip` (String) IPv4 Subnet address
- `src_ipv6` (String) IPv6 Subnet address
- `src_port` (Number) Match only packets with the port number
- `src_port_end` (Number) Ending Port Number
- `src_port_start` (Number) Match only packets in the range of port numbers (Starting Port Number)
- `tcp_flag` (String) 'match-all': not = 0 match = 1; 'none-of': not = 1 match = 0; 'match-any': not = 0 match = 0;
- `tcp_flags_bitmask` (String) Bitmask in Hex
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
